## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数据**（来源：financial_statements.txt，Segment Results 工作表）：

| 期间 | Intelligent Cloud 收入（百万美元） |
|---|---|
| FY26 Q4（截至 2026-06-30 三个月） | **$39,306** |
| FY25 Q4（截至 2025-06-30 三个月） | **$29,878** |

**计算过程**：

$$\text{同比增长率} = \frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} \times 100\% = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \times 100\% \approx 31.55\%$$

微软报告口径为 **32%（按报告口径 GAAP）**；按恒定汇率口径为 **31%**（FX 影响 +$80M，见 press_release.txt 中的分部数据表）。

> 出处：financial_statements.txt Segment Results 工作表；press_release.txt 第 18895 字符处分部对比表。

---

### 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话）

以下为 Amy Hood 在财报电话会上的表述（来源：transcript.txt，第 ~24600–25800 字符）：

> *"Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."*
>
> *"In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."*
>
> *"In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."*

**归因因素汇总**：
- Azure 收入同比 +43%
- 客户需 求持续超过可用产能（"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"）
- CPU 与 GPU 集群的效率提升（"efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet"）
- 流程改进使新产能更早交付（"process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity"）
- 季度内新增 Azure 产能被快速货币化
- GitHub Copilot 在 6 月商业模式调整后消费超预期
- 本地服务器业务基本持平，续签合同中当期收入确认占比更高

---

### 3. 已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

| 类别 | 内容 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| **已发生的事实** | FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 收入 $39.3B，同比增长 32%（31% 恒定汇率） | 财报电话会对已结束季度的回顾；financial_statements.txt 中实际数字 |
| **已发生的事实** | Azure 本季度增长 43% | 同上，为已报告的历史结果 |
| **已发生的事实** | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | 虽然用了"continues"，但这是对当前（Q4 结束时）状态的描述，属于对现状的判断 |
| **已发生的事实** | CPU/GPU 效率提升、流程改进在本季度已经发生并被快速货币化 | 管理层用"Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by…"描述已实现的业绩驱动因素 |
| **已发生的事实** | GitHub Copilot 6 月商业模式调整后消费超预期 | "Results also benefited from…"——描述已实现的结果 |
| **前瞻性表述** | Q1 FY27 Intelligent Cloud 收入指引 $40.95B–$41.25B，同比增长 33%–34% | 明确是展望（"For the outlook for our first quarter…"） |
| **前瞻性表述** | Azure 下季度增长约 45%（恒定汇率） | "In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency" |
| **前瞻性表述** | "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | 明确的前瞻判断（"continue to expect"） |
| **前瞻性表述** | "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | "remain focused""we see"均为面向未来的意图/判断 |
| **前瞻性表述** | "we expect FX to decrease revenue growth in…Intelligent Cloud by less than 1 point" | 汇率影响的前瞻假设 |
| **前瞻性表述** | "year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter" | 风险提示 |

**区分依据说明**：
- **事实**：管理层用过去时态或"was/grew/benefited"描述 Q4 已结束季度的实际结果，且可在财务报表中找到对应数字。
- **前瞻性表述**：管理层使用"expect""continue to expect""remain focused""we see"以及具体数字区间指引未来季度，这些属于前瞻性陈述（forward-looking statements），电话会开头 Microsoft 声明也已提示"does not undertake any duty to update any forward-looking statement"。
